purpose: What Benchmark 001 composes and which gates it must pass. Configuration for scripts/run-benchmark-001.mjs: the harness is generic, this file is the benchmark's composition. Nothing here is a creative outcome; the outcome comes from the run.

product.note: the real photograph is placed as it is: no crop, no relight, no rotation, no shadow

headline.content_basis: the first two sentences of the approved HABB brand line (evidence ev-06 of the canonical Snapshot); non-claim creative text, no number, no fact

not_composed: No logo (no approved logo asset ref exists), no CTA and no decoration: nothing is invented to fill a slot.

all_of: readiness is RUNNABLE with the verified private payload
the document is built from the bound product, the real asset and the approved claims only
Creative Fidelity gate PASS (measured observations for every required check)
Brand Guardian PASS (a measured hard-rule outcome)
a real PNG is produced from a RESOLVED render with real typography

verdicts.PASS: every gate PASS and the PNG exists
verdicts.FAIL: a gate is evaluated and fails
verdicts.BLOCKED: a required gate cannot be measured (NOT_MEASURABLE) or a required condition is missing: no PASS is inferred
